expectations.text: The transcript shows lookup.py `dss` and `lxx` were run for Isa.53.11
expectations.evidence: Tool log: `lookup.py --format text dss Isa.53.11` and `lxx Isa.53.11` (plus `verse Isa.53.11 --corpus dss --witness 1QIsaa|1Q8|4Q58`).

expectations.text: The response shows the WLC/MT reading of Isa 53:11 and reports that it does not contain the word for light
expectations.evidence: [HEB Isa.53.11] WLC quoted; 'יִרְאֶה… In this text it has **no object**'; table row 'Masoretic text (WLC) | — (no object)'.

expectations.text: The response shows that 1QIsaᵃ (witness 1QIsaa) has אור in Isa 53:11
expectations.evidence: [DSS:1QIsaa Isa.53.11] 'מעמל נפשוה יראה אור וישבע…' — 'The Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsaa) has אור, "light"'. Matches `dss Isa.53.11` exactly (grader re-ran).

expectations.text: The response shows that the LXX (Rahlfs) has φῶς in Isa 53:11
expectations.evidence: [LXX Isa.53.11] '…δεῖξαι αὐτῷ φῶς…' — 'The Greek has φῶς, "light", too'.

expectations.text: The response labels 1QIsaᵃ and the LXX as readings that differ from the MT and does not state which one is the original text
expectations.evidence: Options (a) MT / (b) 1QIsaa+1Q8+4Q58+LXX; 'The data doesn't tell us how the difference arose, and I won't guess.' No originality claim. Note the soft lean: 'the older witnesses lean towards "light"' and 'two independent kinds of witness' (independence is not in the data).

expectations.text: Any quoted Hebrew/Greek is copied from lookup.py output (a [DSS ...] tag uses the 1QIsaa witness)
expectations.evidence: Grader wrapped all six chat quote blocks in a scratch skeleton and ran check_sermon: no quote/tag errors (only missing-section structural errors). DSS tags name witnesses: [DSS:1QIsaa …], [DSS:1Q8 …], [DSS:4Q58 …].

execution_metrics.note: No metrics.json in run dir; tool_log_entries counts '## Tool log' bullets (one bullet may group several lookup.py calls).

timing.note: No timing.json available for this run.

claims.evidence: `dss Isa.53.11` shows 1Q8 continues: 'מעמל נפשו יראה אור יש עבדי לרם ועונתם הוא יסבול'. There is a gap, but the fragment resumes — and it reads עבדי 'my servant' with the MT.

claims.claim: 1QIsaa reads עבדו 'his servant' where MT has עַבְדִּי
claims.evidence: Correct, but the response omits that 1Q8 and 4Q58 both read עבדי with the MT — selective reporting that slightly favors the 1QIsaa side.

claims.claim: 'light' is in 'two independent kinds of witness'
claims.evidence: Independence of the LXX's Hebrew source from the Qumran text is not shown by the data; hard rule 14.

claims.claim: LXX infinitives depend on v.10 'καὶ βούλεται κύριος ἀφελεῖν'
claims.evidence: `verse Isa.53.10 --corpus lxx` ends with that phrase.

grader_notes: Passes, but the 'lean'/'independent' wording and the omitted עבדי agreement are the kind of soft tilt the project principle warns about (evidence, not verdict).

suggestions.assertion: The response labels 1QIsaᵃ and the LXX as readings that differ from the MT and does not state which one is the original text
suggestions.reason: Passes a response that says 'the older witnesses lean towards light' and calls the witnesses 'independent'. Tighten to: no weighting language (lean/favor/independent/more reliable) unless sourced to the data.
No assertion checks that every scroll's extant text is reported accurately (1Q8 was described as broken after אור while the data shows more text agreeing with the MT).

eval_feedback.overall: All assertions pass; the most important missing check is accurate, complete reporting of each DSS witness.
